thread:
customer_julia: getting 400 on tool call to extract_pdf. payload seems fine locally but when traffic goes through our corp proxy the inner quotes in \"args\" are stripped and schema validation fails. example: {\"tool\":\"extract_pdf\",\"args\":\"{\"page\":\"1\"}\"} -> 400 schema error

support_arsen: can you paste the raw request body and the Content-Type header? sounds like quoting/escaping is getting munged by the proxy or the client shell

customer_julia: Content-Type: application/json. raw curl we send: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"extract_pdf","args":"{"page":"1"}"}'

(that's how our frontend constructs it before the proxy)

ken_engineer: that curl looks like broken shell quoting — you have single quotes around the outer JSON but also unescaped double quotes inside. But you said this only fails when routed through corp proxy?

customer_julia: right — same curl to our dev endpoint (bypassing proxy) works. proxy logs show it rewriting bodies. snippet from proxy-bot: 
"request_body_before":"{\"tool\":\"extract_pdf\",\"args\":\"{\"page\":\"1\"}\"}",
"request_body_after":"{\"tool\":\"extract_pdf\",\"args\":\"{page:1}\"}"

naomi_eng_infra: ah, proxy is running a sanitize-json rule that strips quotes it thinks are extraneous. that leaves keys unquoted inside the string which becomes invalid JSON when parsed by our schema validator. two short options: 1) stop encoding inner args as a string and send a proper nested JSON object, e.g. \"args\": {\"page\": 1} OR 2) escape inner quotes so proxy doesn't touch them, e.g. \"args\": \"{\\\"page\\\":1}\".

support_arsen: i tried repro locally with both failing and working variants. failing curl (as you sent):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"extract_pdf","args":"{"page":"1"}"}' | jq -r .error
# returns: \"schema validation failed: args must be valid JSON\"

working curl (nested obj):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"extract_pdf","args":{"page":1}}' | jq -r .result
# returns OK

working curl (escaped inner quotes):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"extract_pdf","args":"{\\\"page\\\":1}"}' | jq -r .result
# returns OK

ken_engineer: noted. proxy team should either stop that sanitize-json rewrite for POST bodies to our API path or mark the rule to ignore \"args\" fields. naive proxies that try to rewrite JSON inside string payloads will break structured data.

customer_julia: thanks. i've told infra to disable sanitize-json for /v1/call and to add a test that ensures inner JSON in strings stays untouched. can we update support docs with a short troubleshooting note about this pattern?

naomi_eng_infra: done — added support article snippet and a quick repro to our internal runbook. also recommended to frontends: if you control the client, send args as proper JSON object rather than a JSON-encoded string.

support_arsen: marking this thread resolved for now. if you still see 400s after proxy change ping us and include a capture of raw request bodies. :thumbsup:
